workingDatumBasis: One inspected operator exterior detail photograph establishes the warm stone upper shaft, pale clock faces and ornamental terrace/crowns. The original237m height,114m terrace, stepped tower, low complex wings, eastern portico, two courtyard holes and rounded Congress Hall remain authored/mapped controls. Retain the exact-QID concave relation and signed frame; native-Z points toward the eastern entrance and Congress Hall remains at native+Z. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the complex and road context. Off-footprint PMTiles[-150,0]115.0133m sets approximate terrain contact; center124.8438m contains coarse urban imprint. Rectangular preview correction covers the full complex with raw heights kept separately. Exact sculpture, ceramic ornament, mermaid emblems, window schedule, interior halls and threshold elevations remain approximations or excluded. The cropped picture does not certify the whole low-wing layout; existing mapped controls are retained.
